caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair placed centrally against a plain beige background. The chair has a high backrest with a decorative, wavy top edge and two turned finials at the upper ends of the backrest posts. The backrest consists of a broad rectangular panel. The seat is flat and rectangular, supported by four sturdy legs. Each leg is intricately turned, with decorative elements and connecting stretchers—horizontal rods that connect the legs near their base. The front stretchers are more ornate, featuring additional turning work. The chair has two armrests that are also turned and extend outward, supported by vertical posts. The wood color is light to medium brown, with the wood grain visible throughout the chair. There is a faint inscription below the chair that reads "ROSE CAMPBELL GERKE" in small, capitalized letters. The overall composition is centered, with ample negative space around the chair.
title: Sacristy Chair
